changelog:
- Initial release of gmail-memory skill.
- Enables AI agents to remember, store, and recall Gmail thread context using BlueColumn persistent vector memory.
- Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
- Provides endpoints for storing thread notes, quick notes, and recalling thread history.
- Includes usage workflow and reference to BlueColumn API documentation.
summary: Give AI agents Remember Gmail threads. using BlueColumn persistent memory. Use when an agent manages email and needs thread history; when the user wants to store, recall, or search gmail memory context. Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
